column1: Explain the Virtual DOM in React.
column2: The Virtual DOM is a lightweight copy of the real DOM that React uses to efficiently update UI by comparing differences and applying only necessary changes.

column1: What are media queries in CSS?
column2: Media queries are CSS rules that apply styles conditionally based on device characteristics like screen width or resolution.

column1: What is event bubbling in JavaScript?
column2: Event bubbling is the process where an event triggered on a child element propagates up to its parent elements.
